How to mark yourself. The lab paper is written, not multiple choice. Report a Gram stain as reaction + shape + arrangement (e.g. “Gram-positive cocci in clusters”; rods usually have no arrangement). Name organisms as Genus species and spell them fully. For a test photo, give the name of the test and the reading (positive/negative, what you see). Mark yourself Partial if the organism is right but a key word is missing.
